opening.argument: The video gives viewers a direct route into BitClub Network: it explains how to buy Bitcoin, send it to activate membership, and access a program presented as offering shares in profitable Bitcoin mines. The enrollment page displays a $99 Bitcoin payment option and identifies purchasing shares in profitable mines as a membership benefit. The speaker says, “in this video we will review how you can open a wallet, buy bitcoins and how to send them to your account to activate your membership.” The U.S. Department of Justice describes BitClub's mining-share operation as fraudulent and its displayed mining earnings as false. Taken together, the practical funding instructions and the named scheme's described fraud establish that this is actionable guidance into a purported paid mining-return program, without establishing any specific viewer loss or outcome.
